summary: The Hadoop Engineer focuses on building, maintaining, and optimizing Hadoop clusters and ensuring high availability, scalability, and performance of distributed data systems.
responsibilities: Install, configure, and manage Hadoop clusters
Optimize resource utilization and job scheduling
Implement security, backup, and recovery strategies
Work closely with DevOps and infrastructure teams

education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or equivalent

skills_required.name: Deep understanding of HDFS, YARN, and MapReduce
Experience with cluster management tools (Ambari, Cloudera, Hortonworks)
Knowledge of Kerberos and Hadoop security
